title: Battery cooling · finite-element section
field_note: Y = 0 cut through the 3D FE mesh. Each displayed triangle shows the mean of linearly interpolated FE nodal temperatures on that triangle. Section min/max readouts apply only to this cut; use the full-module history for volume results. Select a material to isolate it. The 25–30°C detail range clips warmer materials.
source_note: Elmer 26.2.1; 2,084,927 tetrahedra, 372,971 nodes, 121 states at 30 s spacing including the initial condition. Assumed equivalent battery properties; transitional flow treated as laminar. Recovered transport velocity differs from original flow by 22.45% in volume-weighted L2 norm. Screening only; no experimental validation.
